params.caption: 🖥️ Nvidia tightens rules on overseas cloud GPU rentals for China Nvidia may limit its cloud partners so that Chinese customers make up no more than 49% of their business, according to Tom's Hardware. The report says Chinese firms have bought more than a million gaming and workstation GPUs, while black-market prices for B300 AI racks have climbed to about $2.8 million. 🕒 Nov 9, 2026 · 20:48 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware #Nvidia #GPU #GamingNews
